title: District Equipment and Uniforms Issued to Participants: Returns, Replacement Charges and Return Credits (Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees)
content:
District equipment and uniforms are issued under **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** only for activity types that issue equipment, each item under its district inventory tag.

- **Return period.** Every item issued on a participation must be returned within the type's equipment return days, calendar days after the participation closes (withdrawn, cut or completed), the closing date being day 0.
- **Replacement charge.** For each item still unreturned after that day, the type's replacement charge posts as an equipment charge for that tag. The charge is not waived by meal status and does not count toward the household fee cap.
- **Return after the charge.** An item returned in usable condition after its charge posted, within the same school year, credits that charge in full as an equipment-returned credit; an item returned in a later school year earns no credit.

## Timeline (hypothetical, return period of 10 days)

| Day | Item status | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | participation closes | return period starts |
| 10 | still out | still within the period |
| after day 10 | still out | one replacement charge posts for that tag |
| later, same school year | returned usable | that charge credited in full |
| later, next school year | returned | no credit |

Each tag stands alone: of two items issued, one returned on time and one not, only the second carries a charge.
